svg.text: The Fair Line: every order lands on the number line
The counter's brass rail: one whole pie from post to post. An order slides piece by piece and stops at its amount; then the buddy's flag shows where it should be
each quarter moves the box one
quarter of the way: three ticks,
then the flag pops up right there:
the gap shows how much more: "A little more, please!"
past the flag: the buddy hands the extra back
A table: fair is side by side
two pies, three buddies: every plate stops at two thirds
five quarters: past post 1, one whole and a quarter.
Whole numbers are fractions too: 8/4 stops on post 2.
